[1] Preston-Myint bụ prọfesọ na Akwụkwọ nke Art Institute of Chicago;  na ọ bụ onye njikwa mmemme na Headlands Center for Arts na Sausalito, California.

Ọ gara ụlọ akwụkwọ CMS Grammar, Lagos site na 1973 ruo 1978, wee gụchaa na College of Medicine, University of Lagos na 1984. Ọ gụchara akara postgraduate ya na ụlọ ọgwụ dị na Ibadan na 1994 na isi nke West African College of Surgeons na  Obstetrics na Gynecology. == Ọrụ ọkachamara ==
N'afọ 2015, Yahaya duuru Mark Mentors gaa n'ọkwa 2015 NPL wee pụta dị ka onye ọkpụkpọ kacha baa uru na asọmpi ahụ.↵Na February 2019, Yahaya bịanyere aka na Rivers Hoopers.. N'ọnwa Nọvemba 2019, Yahaya meriri iko onye isi ala na Hoopers, a na-akpọ ya onye egwuregwu kacha baa uru n'ụzọ.
Na 20 Eprel 2020, Yahaya bịnyere aka na Abidjan Basket Club na Ivory Coast.
